notes.title: New version release 1.2.1
notes.content:
A brand new version has just been released!  ːsteamhappyː
Several new epics, a new story episode, and a bunch of additions.

* A new story episode is available!

* Mutator epics
** Mutator epics let creators alter the behaviour of Mitsu's core abilities
** Active mutators will show for the players in the lower right corner, and will optionally play a sound effect when activated
** Can be instantly activated when entering the adventure, or by triggers while playing
** Available only from the 3rd floor
** The jump mutator:
*** Disable jumps completely, reduce the height of jumps, increase the height of jumps, make jumps insanely high
** The sword mutator:
*** Disable sword attacks completely, make swords stun instead of damage, make sword attacks insta-kill enemies
** The Kunai mutator:
*** Disable Kunais completely, make Kunais damage instead of stun, make Kunais insta-kill enemies
** The run mutator:
*** Disable running completely, make running much faster
** The dash mutator:
*** Disable dashes completely, double the length of all dashes, remove the cooldown of dashes

* Instant Shift epic
** Instantly relocates the player to a specific location around the adventure using a trigger
** Can be set to have a normal teleport transition effect, or no effects at all
** Will heal/revive Mitsu
** The shift will not occur if the target location is obstructed or if Mitsu is mounted

* New Halloween themed pickups! You can find them in the Magical section.

* Pickups now have a smaller collision in the editor, letting creators overlap them a bit more with each other.

* Pine gates can now be placed on castle walls, in which case they will turn into castle gates.

* You can now skip the intro clip with a right mouse click.

That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 1.1.4
notes.content:
This time, we are adding an item that will help creators control the health of players a bit more, as well as nerfing the Marauder somewhat and fixing it a bit.

New Features

* New epic item - Heal pack!
** Sets to heal either Mitsu or a mount
** Can be respawned
** Will not be picked up if Mitsu or the mount are at full health
** Mitsu healing will not show while in mount mode, and vice versa

* Tion Marauder changes
** Health reduced to 5, will now be marked with wrenches
** The Marauder now has a larger explosion radius upon death (which kills anything, including Mitsu)
** Missiles will now only do 1 damage (instead of insta-killing) - But will be fired more rapidly
** A (very short) countdown will now show when the mount calls you to eject
** The instructions panel can now be hidden by pressing X
** Death trigger can now be configured, that will activate once the mount explodes

Bug Fixes

* No more glorious endless explosions when a mount with a respawn color dies

* Deaths from the Marauder will now be correctly labeled on death swords and death messages

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 1.1.3
notes.content:
In this version we introduce the first mountable item in Kryll - The Tion Marauder!
Apart from that (and the whole new mount system) there are several more fixes and additions.

New Features

* The Tion Marauder is here!
** This is the first mount that Mitsu can use!
** Dash into the Marauder to take control, the instructions on how to use it will show
** Mounts have a separate health bar, and will not regenerate health via spawn points
** You can link a mount to a respawn color, to respawn it (It will not respawn if it is currently in use)
** The Marauder is extremely powerful and durable, but lacks manoeuvrability
** While inside a mount Mitsu cannot perform some specific tasks (Such as praying at shrines or talking to NPCs)

* Added a few new pickup/decoration items

* It is now possible to use the sandbox even if you have an adventure under construction.
** To do that, press Ctrl+S while in the map (tooltips mention that)
** You cannot enter the sandbox while inside the editor - Only while playing normally

Bug Fixes

* Pasting text into the game (chat / editor textboxes) works again

* Cadmeon which changed its horizontal/vertical direction with nudges would not reset correctly after respawning

* Kunais will now never 'skip' musical notes when activating them in a row

* The world map's info overlay will not show ranks for the training areas

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 1.0.9
notes.content:
This time we greatly improved the gamepad support (you can even use the editor with a controller now! Even though the mouse will still be superior for it), and also added a few interesting features and fixes.
Don't hurt too many snow bunnies!

New Features

* Better gamepad support!
** The left analogue stick will now work as well as the D-Pad
** You can now also emulate the mouse using the controller!
*** R-Stick will move the mouse cursor
*** The left shoulder buttons (LT/LB) will left-click/right-click
*** R3 will also left-click
** A controller layout schematic was added to show how to play using a controller
*** You can see it via the 'Control scheme' button in the player panel (at the bottom of the player panel)
** Please let us know if you wish more functions to be mapped to other controller buttons

* Automatic death swords
** Players will now randomly leave death swords about why they died for other players to see
** You will not see your own automatic death swords (you will see the sword as usual, but not the message from it)
** These death swords will not be marked as prominently as the normal death-notes
** There are many limitations to placing automatic swords, so they will only appear sporadically and not overwhelm the world
** Naturally, death-note swords have a much higher priority then these swords

* New tileset - Snowy fields
** You can find it in the epics panel
** The matching snowy cavern was added to the nature background color palette
** Comes with a matching snow bunny!

* The Takara forest and Sapphire caverns shrines can now be placed on any terrain

* The locking feature (The yellow lock on the bottom bar) will now only be available after completing at least 4 adventures

Bug Fixes

* Death notes that players added did not show for them until they restarted the game

* The race music kept playing after teleporting to a new place during an ongoing race

* The "Barrier smasher" achievement was awarded at the wrong time

* The training areas were showing ranks and guestbook posts on the map in certain situations

* Various spelling fixes

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 1.0.0 (!!)
notes.content:
Is this it..? The Steam release build?
More fine tuning and additions, moderation tools, some bug fixes and a brand new intro!

New Features

* Guestbook moderation tools
** It is now possible to delete unwanted guestbook posts
** Deleted guestbook posts will not be completely removed, and will show who deleted them
** Only these people can delete guestbook posts:
*** Players can delete their own posts
*** Adventure owners can delete any post in their own adventures

* New intro clip!
** Will show before the login screen
** Can be skipped by pressing ESC

* Improvements to the map
** We noticed that some players miss the ability to teleport to an entrance of an adventure, so we changed the button a bit
*** It was split to two buttons - 'Teleport to shrine' and 'Teleport to entrance'
*** The art better reflects the function of the buttons
** The map cursor will turn red if it hovers above a place which cannot be teleported to
** The map tutorial now explains about zooming in/out

* Chat behaviour for over-crowded rooms
** An over-crowded chat room is a room with more then 10 players in it
** When entering an over-crowded room, only the amount of players in it will show and not their names
** '/who' will still show the complete list of players
** Enter/Leave messages will automatically be silenced and hidden when the room is over-crowded
*** Opening the chat will still show those messages
** This applies to all types of chat rooms - Local chat, General, Private rooms etc...

* The Below Kryll logo on the login screen now appears... better

* The death count will now show in the player panel

* Shortened the gold for praying indicator at the top right corner

* NPC changes
** Some NPCs were recolored to better reflect their portraits
** The businessman is actually wearing a suit with a tie now 
** The scientist's blush portrait was altered a bit

* The tutorial is now called training, and was changed in all the relevant places

Bug Fixes

* Piko plants will show their colors based on true RGB values
** The default green plant color will not be harmed in any way
** The other colors will be much darker now due to the new calculations
*** This was not an easy decision to make, since it changes existing Piko plants around the world - But since we are just before release, we decided to do it for the future!

* Initiating a dialog with an NPC and pressing TAB at the same time will now close the dialog correctly

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.6.0b
notes.content:
Art, art, art!
This time we have improved the dialogs appearance and portraits of all the characters in the game, as well as a brand new splash screen and logo design.
Even more music tracks have been added, and some more fixes and additions as we get even closer to the release date!

New Features

* New dialogs look and portraits
** Brand new high detailed art for all the characters in the game!
** Dialogs received a major 'facelift', and now look better and their animations are much smoother
** A new 'Expression effect' feature added, letting creators give a bit more life to chosen dialog lines
*** 'Emphasize' will make the character bounce a bit, emphasizing their current dialog
*** 'Get farther' will make the character move backwards, as if getting farther from the person they speak to
*** 'Get closer' will make the character advance forward, as if getting closer to the person they speak to
*** 'Shaking' will make the character constantly shake

* New splash screen and logo!
** The splash screen now transitions better into the game
** We will gradually add all these new assets to Steam, our website, etc...

* Pickup look picker enhancements/fixes
** Added a button that links to the forum post about contributing images and descriptions
** Will now behave normally if opened while in inspect mode
** The mouse cursor will now always be normal when using the pickup look picker

* Music additions
** New sad music that plays while you are dead
** New map music that plays while using the map/search

* Executable only: Music will now be stored locally and not stream from the server
** This addition will NOT update automatically, though it will fall back on streaming if the music is not found locally
** To update your version to get music locally, you will need to re-download the game from scratch
*** In steam, you can 'remove local content' and install the game again
*** If you are using the normal executable version, you can re-download it from the website

* The login screen has been made simpler to understand
** MOTD is gone
** The trailer clip will no longer play there
** New logo!

* Mitsu and the NPCs have been tanning a bit, and are now more saturated

* Changed the icon of the game :)

Bug Fixes

* Being invincible while going into the void will no longer save you from death

* The teaser image will no longer be selectable and copyable
** When attempting to edit an adventure that was already published with multiple teaser images, all will be removed but one 

* Open tutorials will now be correctly closed when entering the editor

* The Ticks mode timer continued ticking even while the game was paused

* Incognito mode label was showing after leaving the login screen

* The exploration bonus in the character sheet would sometimes indicate remaining time for the bonus while it was already available

* It is now possible to background-draw on the very bottom line of an adventure (Kudos on the biggest background painting around Kryll, mostro!)

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.5.0b
notes.content:
In this version we added some needed privacy options for players, getting ready for a broader community.
There are also a lot of enhancements and additions for existing items and features such as the Pickups and the Ticks collection mode.
And for the first time, these release notes will actually be accessible in-game!

New Features

* More pickup features!
** Pickups can now be rotated and flipped. Ever wanted a cat sitting on the ceiling? Now it's finally possible!
** Pickups are now called 'Pickup/Decoration' and the option to set them as decorations is better marked in their properties window
** Even more pickup contributions! (Thanks Gors and fervour!)
** New pickup category - Tools - Some images were moved there from Misc as well

* Ticks mode enhancements
** A new tutorial popup will explain the Ticks mode better and with much less text then before
** When getting a dethroned update, the client will refresh the Ticks records for that adventure, showing the correct values - even if you are not there physically (virtually?)
** The amount of collected Ticks will now show up in the chat after you complete a collection, whether you made first place or not
** While in Ticks mode, the HUD will show the current record that you are trying to beat
** The Tick animation on the Ticks button was replaced with a crown since the animated Tick was a bit too distracting

* Halcyons can now be set to instantly explode when triggered!
** These highly unstable Halcyons will be marked accordingly

* Our logo was added to the beginning (Yes, we actually have a logo!)

* In-game release notes
** You can now check out the latest release notes from within the game
** After a new release is released, an update about the new release notes will be in the updates panel
** You can also access the latest release notes via the player panel

* Incognito mode
** A new option in the login screen will now let players play the game in 'Incognito mode'
** While in this mode, the chat will be completely disabled, you will be untraceable, and you will not see other players or be seen by other players around you
** Other features in the game should work normally, including guestbooks/updates/etc...
** This option is always off by default, and players will be warned about missing features when they choose it
** This is NOT an offline mode - you will obviously still need an internet connection to play 

* Block player
** It is now possible to block and unblock players via the player details panel (You can access it by clicking on avatars, or nicknames in the chat)
** A new chat command /blocklist will show you all the players you currently block
** Blocking players will block all their incoming chat and hide them from your gameplay

* You can now see when an adventure was created in the adventure info panel (TAB while playing)

* Some transitions are now smoother
** The black circles that transition between teleportations
** The initial search for recently created adventures before the game starts

* The 4th Mitsu's Tales episode now has better explanations about how to sneak around Emori fighters

* The 'Rapid Dash' super power in Mitsu's tales was renamed to 'Spirit Dash' :)

* 'D:' will also show the ':O' emoticon

* The 'Running' skill description in the character sheet will now also mention the SHIFT key alternative

Bug Fixes

* The Pickup look picker would remain open if left open while the item was deleted - resulting in a possible crush

* The 'Spirit Dash' bug was fixed

* Post dates in the guestbooks (and some other places) now show years if needed

* ESC will cancel the 'Reached the void' dialog now

* The wind ambiance was randomly playing during the login screen

* Empty lines (even if they include spaces) were still being sent via chat

* The ':/' emoticon will no longer appear when inside a sentence (http:// will be fine again!)

* A mysterious message about a level up of an unnamed player could potentially show when a player has a really bad connection

* The Summon epic is now limited to 5 per adventure, since there are only 5 Summon colors

===
That's all folks.
Enjoy!

notes.content:
A huge version this time, we several new features!
This time we added a big feature that enhances the replayability of adventures - letting players experience the same content with a very different purpose in mind.
Your art donations are great! So we also improved the recently released Pickup item, making it easier to manage and also adding an option to be a decoration instead of an active item.
Another improvement is in the emoticons area - We expanded the variety and added some extra unique emoticons that can be unlocked by completing certain tasks.
On top of these additions, there are several more improvements and fixes as we get closer to the official release of the game!

* The Ticks have arrived!
** Ticks have invaded Kryll and your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to grab as many of them as you can!
** Once you complete an adventure (no need to perfect), you will gain access to the Ticks mode
** Toggle the Ticks mode via the button that appears at the top right - or [F1]
** Once in Ticks mode, night will fall and Ticks will populate the adventure
** Though randomly populated - the Ticks will always appear at the same places in the adventure - so you can learn where they are for future attempts
** You only have a very limited time in which you can collect as much as you can, before morning comes again and the Ticks disappear
** Some Ticks may be unreachable, and it is very unlikely that you will grab all of them before the time runs out
** More 'open' adventures will have more Ticks, and cramped up adventures will have less (Usually between 100-500 ticks)
** Adventures with more Ticks will give you more time for the collection event
** To complete your collection event, you can either wait it out or toggle it yourself - There is no need to reach the shrine
** Leaving the adventure or restarting it will also stop any ongoing collection event (you will still be credited if you reach a high score)
** To get a record you must pass the current record (Getting the same amount will not get you your reward)
** Managing to collect the most Ticks in an adventure will crown you the master of that adventure, giving you some rewards:
*** A crown will show above your head in that adventure to players around you
*** A crown will show in the local chat of that adventure
*** Your record, avatar and name will show in the top right corner of that adventure
*** Your Magic Marker will gain Tick color powers
** If the creator of the adventure republishes it, the Ticks record will be cleared and all the Ticks locations in that adventures will be randomized again
** You will get an update if someone dethrones you, or if the adventure was republished
** New music will play as you engage in the Ticks collection! (Some players might remember it from Temporal)
** Some tips for grabbing the most Ticks:
*** Initial positioning is crucial! - Try to find out what starting position will give you the fastest access to the most Ticks
*** You may want to 'set up' the place first - Pushing blocks, opening doors or killing enemies may save you precious seconds later on
*** Locking yourself to the adventure can be useful - Remember, only restarting or leaving is forbidden - but respawning is fine

* Chat emoticons now have a dedicated skill slot in the character sheet.
** More emoticons were added!
** Unlock special emoticons by performing certain tasks - Check out the skill description to figure out what.

* The Pickup item had some interesting changes and additions:
** The pickup look chooser is now much more convenient and divided into categories for easy browsing
** Many new skins for the pickups - (Thanks Gors and Eeveeiott!)
** The blink of pickup-able pickups is now more prominent
** You can set the pickup to be a decoration, in this state the pickup will not blink and the player cannot pick it up
*** You can still make the item appear with a trigger, or set a name for it
*** The respawn color is disabled if the pickup is set to be a decoration

* The Mitsu Tales music is now different for each episode (based on it's content)
** There is also a brand new music track as well! You can check it out in episodes 1, 4 and 7

* You can now search for adventures that contain race flags, in the adventure finder

* Pickups were added to various existing Mitsu's tales episodes

* The daily bonus section in the character sheet now shows how much time is left for the next bonus (not only in the tooltip)

* All the non platforming/action skills (like Gold Magnet, Magic marker, etc...) will not be locked by your effective level when testing your own adventures

BUG FIXES:

* The conditions for getting the perfected Mitsu's tales episodes' achievements where very wrong
* The tutorial adventures do not show completions/perfections/+1 counts on the map anymore
* The caverns Obelisk and Slab where accidentally replaced with a forest Sign and Plague
* Copy pasting the Dragon mouth to an opposite wall would not flip it as needed
* ESC didn't close the Mitsu's Tales panel

Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.4.222b
notes.content:
Version time!
This time, a couple of new items (one of them is a new addition to the normal items!) and a story episode that shows some of the things that can be done using those items.
And ofc, a few fixes as well :)

* New Mitsu's tales episode (episode X)!

* New story normal item - the Pickup
** Finally Mitsu can collect not only shurikens during his adventures
** Pickups can be configured to have different looks
** Like points of interest, the pickups can appear when triggered, and will send a trigger when touched
** You can choose out of 4 different effects that will show when the pickup is touched
** Pickups can be respawned and named
** We are looking to expand the variety of pickup looks - and you might be able to help as well! More on that later.

* New epic - the Pickup Rush
** Force the player to collect certain pickups in a set amount of time (can also be configured to not be time limited)
** This mini-event can also be configured to add bonus time for every pickup touched
** The rush will automatically work on all the pickups with the same respawn color as the rush
** Triggering the respawn will reset the rush (and it's items)
** Can be configured to send a win trigger or fail trigger based on the result of the rush
** The rush will show on the HUD, and can include a personalized text
** New achievement for a successful rush (which is in an adventure that does not belong to you)
** Since the event is represented on the HUD - you can only have a single pickup rush event in an adventure

* A small change to the 4th tutorial, showing the usage of pickups

Executable only:

* The 'Turn on fullscreen' popup will not show for the executable version anymore (the last fullscreen state will be remembered)

* Quitting via the 'Quit' button in the settings will now save the last position and size of the game - which will be restored when started again

Bug fixes:

* WIP areas will not show in the search results anymore
* Swords with death messages will be removed after publishing an adventure, to avoid them being stuck in impossible places
* Racing and pressing Z to respawn caused the race music to stop and the normal music to start playing
* Under certain conditions the WIP epic stayed even when deleted (visual bug)
* The "Update Get!" popup will not appear anymore after the update panel has been opened
* Getting the 'already has an unpublished adventure' death message now shows correctly
* Minor fix to episode 9 preventing players from activating a goblin trigger that should not be activated

Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.4.221b
notes.content:
Version time!
This time, we finally add lots of Steam achievements, as well as a couple of new features and some fixes.

* Steam achievements!
** 33 achievements were created for Steam
** More achievements will be added in the future
** Veteran players who have already performed the tasks for those achievements can still get them by performing the following tasks:
*** Perform a new completion
*** Perform a new perfection
*** Open a race replay which you have won
*** Complete an unranked adventure that you didn't create
*** Complete and perfect a new story episode
*** Teleport to each base floor
*** Level up
*** There are a few secret achievements which you can also get if you know what you are doing - please don't discuss those here

* The Summon epic now has a new togglable option: 'Also respawn'
** Checking this option will also make the summon epic respawn/reset-position of the marked items/creatures
** To retrigger the summon, the trigger should be turned off and on again

* Right clicking a chat channel will now toggle between 3 settings:
** Normal - Chat will be shown and heard even if the chat panel is closed
** Hidden - Chat will not be shown, but will be heard if the chat panel is closed
** Hidden&Silenced - Chat will not be shown or heard if the chat panel is closed

* Caps Lock is now supported in chat

* Mitsu will not be able to attempt to leave tales episodes to the left or right - as if blocked by invisible walls

Bug fixes:

* 'press Z to restart' shifted a bit too low in the death popup
* The settings button stopped functioning while playing the game (ESC still worked)
* ESC didn't close the player-panel and the adventure-info windows
* Ignoring the level up indicator would make the sparks remain active even when you enter edit mode

Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.4.219b
notes.content:
A new version is here!
This now, a new episode which introduces an interesting new item into the mix!

* [b]Mitsu's tales episode IX can now be played![/b]
** This episode shows off the new Nudge feature, and advances the story

* [b]The Nudge epic[/b]
** Nudge creatures that usually roam in specific patterns to act as you wish
** Make them jump, turn, stop at their tracks or drop down thin bridges
** Works only on creatures that roam, which are currently Bonons, Enura, Cadmeons, Mooks and Emori fighters when set on patrol
** When stopped, the creature will still harm the player (it is not stunned) and will resume normal roaming after being hit, stunned or dropped
** Nudges can optionally have triggers which can set them to be active or not

* Emory fighters now have a new setting that let them have no alert vision, and only become alerted only when hit or touched by Mitsu

* Points of interest will now have a configurable respawn colors, letting creators easily restart them when needed

* Enhancements to the adventure finder!
** Will show up instantly after login (so it won't interfere with things that show up after login) and Closing it will resume the game instantly
** The results for the first automatic search (the latest creations) will show all together and not one by one
** Added a one time tutorial for the first time it opens
** WIP and Passage adventures are now marked correctly
** Unranked icon changed
** Ability to browse the results using the movement keys (Arrows/WASD); ENTER will open the map for a marked result
** C will open/close the search criteria window
** TAB will start selecting text fields, and jump between them
** ENTER will execute a new search

* The ESCAPE key can now be used throughout the game to close popups/windows
** Will also remove the focus from any text box if it is currently being edited
** Will also close the chat, without discarding what was written in the chat-line
** If everything is already closed, it will toggle the settings menu
** Notice that in the web version ESC also exists fullscreen - this cannot be changed

* Text SFX's collision is much smaller, letting you place several at a very close proximity in the editor

* Swapped the left/right buttons on all platforms to cause less confusion

* Shift+clicking while in inspect mode will now switch to normal draw mode, so copy-pasting items will be possible

**Bug fixes:**

* Emory fighters would potentially stop patrolling after killing Mitsu (or behave unexpectedly)
* When the background color picker showed at the top (due to the editor scrolled to the bottom) some of it's buttons could not be pressed
* The XP bar will now be above the Mitsu's tales UI
* Passage areas will now longer show the 'unranked adventure' tutorial
* Emori units will get alerted when directly attacked by Mitsu
* When downloading a new version at some (highly unlikely) situations the older version was cached and used instead

Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.4.217b
notes.content:
Ever wanted to find a highly ranked platforming adventure that you didn't perfect yet?
How about a very difficult puzzle in the Sapphire caverns? Or an adventure with both music and art in it?
Maybe you just want to remember where 'sinep' was?
Now you can finally find these, and much more, with the new adventure finder!

[list]
 [*] Introducing - [b]The adventure finder![/b]
[list]
[*] Search for adventures based on many different fields, sorted by either date of creation or rank
[*] The results of the search can open the map at the adventure's location
[*] Read the tooltips in the criteria settings window to learn more about what you can search for
[*] The adventure finder will open up automatically after login, and show the latest creations around the world
[*] Open/close the finder with 'F' from pretty much anywhere (including the editor)
[*] The map has a new button that will also open the finder
[*] Notice that the search results will only include adventures that are not farther then 300 map slots away (that's VERY far) from your current position
[*] This is not the case with the default 'recent creations' search, which shows all the newest adventures globally
[/list]
 [*] New normal item - [b]The logic Set/Reset (SR)[/b], also known as a Flip-flop gate
[list]
[*] A simple logic gate that will make turning on and off triggers far easier then before
[*] Gets an 'ON trigger' and 'OFF trigger' inputs, and has a single output trigger
[*] If the ON trigger is activated, the output trigger will start to be constantly active
[*] If the OFF trigger is activated, the output trigger will start to be constantly inactive
[*] You can decide what the initial state of the output trigger will be
[*] Notice that you can re-trigger the ON or OFF as much as you want to turn the output on or off
[*] If some input trigger remains constantly active (for example, if the ON trigger is constantly active) - it will not change the output until that input trigger stops being active and returns to be active again
[/list]

 [*] The 'claim adventure' button on the popup that shows when you enter the void, will now have a tooltip explaining the gradual increase in cost and 5k gold cap.

 [*] general button press, error and locking sfx changes

[/list]

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]

[list]

 [*] Spikes will no longer prevent items originally placed on them from respawning

[/list]


Enjoy!

notes.title: New version release 0.4.216b
notes.content:
A new version has been released!
As usual, new versions will update themselves automatically.

[b] New features: [/b]

[list]

[*] Unranked adventures will now give twice the gold (from shurikens and killing things) of a ranked adventure
- Also removed the obsolete +Gold marks on the map, making the map much cleaner to look at
- Added a new tutorial about the unranked bonus when entering an unranked area for the first time

[*] Epic items can now be tested in sandbox mode (you get a specific amount of each, suitable for testing)

[*] Guestbooks for any adventure can now be read directly from the map!
- You can see the guestbook button in the map teaser popup that shows up
- Click the button, or press G to open the guestbook of that adventure - no need to reach it first

[*] TAB and Shift+TAB can now be used to select and jump between text boxes while editing items in the editor

[*] Premium account teaser will now show for trial players after they login, if they finished the tutorial already
- Can be dismissed by pressing TAB (or the designated button)

[*] Changed the Greenlight banner at the login screen to a Steam banner

[*] ISSUE FIX: If someone keeps disconnecting and reconnecting from the chat too much, they will have a 24h cooldown from the chat (resets upon relogin)
[/list]

[b] Bug fixes: [/b]

[list]
[*] Resizing the game's window while the game was paused caused a visual glitch
[*]  Emory fighters' vision cone would remain after their death in certain cases (Thanks mostro!)
[*] Open chat (and some other UI elements) could have potentially obstruct the "Entered the void" question popup, making it impossible to interact with
[*] When posting on a guestbook that does not belong to the current adventure (opening it from the updates feeds / map) the post count on that guestbook would show a wrong value
[*] Completing an adventure for the first time before the area name banner disappeared would cause the banner to get stuck until leaving the adventure
[*] The player lookup nickname textbox did not support max length nicknames
[/list]
